verdict.rationale: Buzz's own agent runtime (buzz-agent) is an MCP client that runs tool calls via MCP. Persona Packs bundle MCP server config, and Block ships buzz-dev-mcp as a server the agent consumes, so plugging MCP servers into Buzz agents is a documented capability. Coverage is incomplete because the evidence only mentions MCP config inside packs and does not show the user-facing steps for adding arbitrary third-party MCP servers. missing for 10: documented step-by-step configuration for adding arbitrary MCP servers (Desktop/CLI settings or config format details), evidence of tool discovery/permissioning for plugged-in servers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: call the LLM → get tool calls → run them via MCP → feed results back → repeat
A pack contains: personas (identity + system prompt), skills (on-demand instruction sets), MCP server config, pack-level instructions, lifecycle hooks, and distribution metadata
It gives any agent a shell and a file editor.
